design_goals.A20-generation-v2: A18→A19 combo generation; should combine benefits not harms
design_goals.A21-generation-v2+F4: A20 tree + dynamic-F4 + single champion/parent; should lift conditional Top2
design_goals.A22-adaptive-local-rescue: A21 + low-margin/schema-repair reserve challenger (max 1); still single champion

observed_headline.note: A20 Top2 47.1% ≈ A-raw 49.0%; Top1 39.2% ≈ A-raw 41.2%. A21 Top2 51.0% ties C-prod but Top1 collapses to 27.5%. A22 Top2 49.0% Top1 31.4%; rescue partially patches A21.

summary.verdict: A20 does NOT cleanly combine A18+A19 benefits. It partially heals some A18/A19 harms but retains a subset of each and introduces novel combo Top1 losses. Net vs A-raw: Top1 -1 cells, Top2 -1 cells.
mechanisms: Sequential A18 parent-safe gate then A19 budget=4 (apply_generation_v2_combo).
A18 harms that survive: parent-gate moves gold to reserve or deletes local champion path; intergroup demotion.
A19 harms that survive/echo: budget cap yields non-gold active set → intergroup_rank_loss.
Healing: combo repairs some A18-only and A19-only losses.
Novel harms: cells where A18 and A19 both kept success vs raw but A20 loses (gate×budget interaction).

summary.verdict: CRITICAL DESIGN MISS: dynamic-F4 on A20 tree lifts Top2 to 51.0% (net +1 vs raw) while Top1 collapses 41.2%→27.5% (net -7). Dominant mechanism is NOT deleting gold: 8/11 Top1 regressions are rank==2 with gold still among local champions (Top2 hit). Several demotions keep identical champion IDs and only reorder via F4 local scores × parent mass — converting Top1→Top2. Absolute Top1 equals A4-v2-ref (27.5%).

vs_A20_same_tree.note: A20 uses local_mode=true (fixed true-round facts); A21 uses dynamic F4 — pure downstream delta on identical A20 trees.

mechanisms: Same source_tree_arm=A20-generation-v2; only local_mode flips true→dynamic (stop_after=4).
champions_per_parent=1: a single local winner permanently represents each parent.

PRIMARY Top1-collapse mode (8/11 regs): gold remains a local champion but global rank==2 (still Top2). Of A20-rank1→A21-rank2 cells, several keep the SAME champion IDs — dynamic-F4 changes local_score/parent-mass ordering among champions (score reorder), not gold elimination.
Only 1/11 Top1 regs displace gold off the champion set (mxh046::r01); 2/11 are local_champion_elimination.
Joint arbitration uses parent_posterior × local_score: non-top gold under a lighter parent loses Top1 while a sibling non-gold champion under a heavier parent wins — Top2 preserved via parent mass.
top2_given_local_champion rises (0.774→0.897) — conditional Top2 goal met; unconditional Top1 sacrificed.
Pattern mirrors A4-v2-ref Top1=27.5% with high conditional Top2.

summary.verdict: Rescue fires on many low-margin parents; Top1 vs A21 improves (gains=6, losses=4, net=2) matching ~+6/−4 patching, but absolute Top1 (31.4%) remains far below A-raw (41.2%). challenger_won gold=4/10 (40.0%).

vs_A21.note: Global A22−A21 Top1 flip counts are the user-observed rescue +/−; not all flips have rescue_trace (stochastic local recompute), but most rescue cells with outcome≠neutral align with these flips.

mechanisms: Trigger: repair_used OR local_margin < 0.08; reopen one reserve challenger for second dynamic-F4 pass.
Still champions_per_parent=1: winning challenger fully replaces first-pass winner.
Many triggers at margin=0.0 — low information; noisy reopen.
Partial recovery when challenger is gold; non-gold wins explain residual regressions.

A20: Do not treat A18→A19 as commutative benefit stacking: A20 retains subsets of both A18 and A19 harms and adds novel combo Top1 losses.
Audit survived A18 harms (mb83_foreignbody / mxh046): parent-safe reserve moves gold off active or off local champion; budget step does not restore them.
Audit survived/novel A19-style harms (mb55_glucagonoma): budget cap leaves non-gold active champions → intergroup_rank_loss.
Consider budget-aware parent gate or gold-preserving reserve promotion before single-cap4, rather than sequential A18 then A19.
A21: CRITICAL: dynamic-F4 + single champion converts Top1→rank2 while preserving Top2; conditional Top2 rises, unconditional Top1 collapses.
Fix target is joint score calibration / anti-demotion, not only champion identity: same champion sets still flip 1→2 under F4 scores.
Options: (a) drop dynamic-F4 for Top1 endpoints; (b) multi-champion per parent; (c) temper parent_mass in arbitration; (d) freeze ordering when local margin low.
Do not ship A21 as primary if Top1 matters — mirrors A4-v2-ref Top1=27.5%.
Prioritize A20_ok→A21_hurt cells (n=9); A22 only fully recovers 4/9.
A22: Rescue is a weak partial patch: Top1 vs A21 improves (~+6/−4 style) but absolute Top1 stays far below A-raw.
When challenger_won, challenger is often NOT gold — gate on quality or keep first-pass if already rank≤2.
Many triggers at margin=0.0 (degenerate); skip reserve reopen unless repair_used or margin in (0, threshold).
Target rescue at F4-displaced-gold parents specifically (compare first-pass vs reserve gold leaf).
cross_arm: A20 ≈ A-raw Top2 without compounding A18/A19 benefits; A21 is the Top1 destroyer; A22 weakly patches A21.
Path: fix A20 lineage harms → drop or redesign dynamic-F4 for Top1 → rescue only for schema-repair + gold-in-reserve.

A20.one_liner: Combo partially heals A18/A19 harms but retains 2 A18 + 4 A19 Top1 losses and adds novel mxh011::r03; net ≈ A-raw.

A21.one_liner: Top2↑ via parent-mass rank2 retention; Top1↓ because F4 reorders champions (often same IDs) from rank1→2.

A22.one_liner: Rescue +6/−4 Top1 vs A21; only 4/10 challenger_won are gold; recovers 4/9 A20_ok→A21_hurt cells; margin=0.0 triggers dominate.
